channel.title: Ente development digest
channel.description: AI-generated daily digest of PRs opened and merged in the Ente monorepo

item.title: Ente digest Oct 05, 2026 - 28 shipped, 6 in progress
item.description:
Ente shipped a broad set of media playback, sharing, editing, and messaging improvements across Photos and Space. Work in progress includes easier viewer sharing, Android push-notification registration, and a new server-side “friend” change.

Shipped

  • Photos web: Feed and carousel videos now preload nearby content and autoplay after scrolling settles, with swiped carousels and manual playback taking priority (#13403, #13386). Single-video quick links also start muted automatically (#13352).
  • Photos web: Albums, public albums, and embeds can now sort files by filename in ascending or descending order (#13353). Firefox Android video covers and timeline previews are more reliable, with clearer processing and diagnostics (#13398).
  • Photos mobile: Offline Local Gallery now hides Feed and presents Home, Albums, and Search instead (#13395). Android users can share multiple Locker files at once (#13221), and participant options open with a long press (#13379).
  • Photos editing: The image editor adds text layers with fonts, styling, colors, alignment, and layer editing alongside stickers and drawings (#13121). Discarding changes in a sub-editor now returns cleanly to the main editor (#13378).
  • Photos memories: Memory Lane now supports background music in the memories strip, with persistent mute controls and always-visible navigation dots (#13335).
  • Space web: Failed posts can be retried, upload diagnostics can be downloaded, and message action menus are easier to discover and dismiss (#13388, #13360, #13399). Reactions now have subtle motion that respects reduced-motion settings (#13381).
  • Desktop and Auth: Auth on Windows remembers its window placement and maximized state (#13372), while Auth gains a Cybersicherheitsportal icon (#13109). Desktop uploads now use preview metadata when available (#13237).

Other merged work covered dependency and security maintenance, deployment tooling, and internal performance improvements.

In progress

  • Viewer sharing: A new compact sharing dock would put “Send link” alongside photo/video sharing in the mobile viewer (#13400).
  • Android notifications: Photos is preparing Android device registration for push notifications, including token refresh and logout safety; production Firebase setup and server routing remain rollout considerations (#13397).
  • Server: A new friend-related change is under development, though no further details are included yet (#13405).
  • Additional work improves upload-verification efficiency (#13404), refreshes compatible web dependencies (#13394), and softens mobile viewer gradients (#13392).

item.title: Ente digest Oct 03, 2026 - 1 shipped, 2 in progress
item.description:
A mobile camera dependency upgrade has shipped to address scanner crashes on iPhone 17. Two improvements are in progress: clearer message actions in Space web and a new Boxcar Trading icon for Ente Auth.

Shipped

In progress

item.title: Ente digest Oct 02, 2026 - 22 shipped, 6 in progress
item.description:
Today’s merged work focused on Photos usability and performance, safer sharing, and mobile reliability. Several upcoming changes also target easier album organization, smoother video sharing, and richer Memories playback.

Shipped

  • Photos mobile: [refreshed onboarding and Local Gallery flows] improve copy and layout while making notification-permission retries less disruptive; [map markers] now use rounded photo pins and count badges; and [OCR failures] appear as dismissible toasts instead of persistent banners.
  • Photos across mobile and web: [OCR now uses Vision on iOS and Rust OCR on Android] for all users, with model caching and lifecycle improvements. [Share downloads] stream encrypted data in chunks, reducing memory use for large files.
  • Reliability and privacy: [iOS startup and simulator initialization fixes] address newer iOS and Apple Silicon environments. The server now [filters private fields from shared collections] and [redacts public-link request bodies].
  • Auth and sharing: Auth QR codes can [switch finder squares to black on tap] for hardware authenticator compatibility. Space web messages now [make URLs clickable].
  • Other merged maintenance includes [streamed motion-photo processing], [owner-only Auth export permissions], and ML/database groundwork in [13322] and [13325].

In progress

  • Album organization: [mobile] and [web] add natural filename sorting within albums.
  • Video sharing: [single-video quick links] will start muted autoplay, with sound available through the existing control.
  • Memories: [Memory Lane v2] adds background music support and always-visible navigation dots.
  • [Camera dependency upgrade] targets iPhone 17 scanner crashes, while [Space message hover actions] makes reactions, replies, copying, and deletion easier to discover.

item.title: Ente digest Oct 01, 2026 - 43 shipped, 7 in progress
item.description:
Today’s shipped work improves media handling, OCR, sharing, and upload feedback across Ente Photos and Space, alongside several security and reliability hardening changes. In progress, the team is iterating on onboarding, Memories, exports, notifications, and Auth settings.

Shipped

  • Photos and mobile: Native Vision OCR is now used on iOS and Rust OCR on Android for all users, with cached model downloads and better memory cleanup on Android (#13332). The crop editor also gains a manual straighten control, improved zoom behavior, and clearer “Crop & rotate” labeling (#13204).
  • Initial people and themed Memories can now trigger a one-time notification when ready in the background (#13242).
  • Space: Posts now support up to 10 mixed photos and videos, including locally processed clips up to 10 seconds, trimming, cover selection, and reordering (#13291). Links in messages are clickable and open in a new tab (#13329).
  • Web and sharing: Share downloads now stream encrypted files in chunks instead of buffering the entire file, improving handling of large downloads (#13333). Photos upload failures are now separated from skipped files and highlighted in red (#13318), while Locker users can rename pending files before upload (#13327).
  • Photos now requires authentication before opening the password-change form (#13326). Remote ML metadata and Live Photo archive decoding also have bounded decompression paths for safer resource use (#13322, #13302).
  • CLI and maintenance: Shell completion no longer requires keyring access (#13323); routine dependency, translation, CI, and security updates were also merged.

In progress

  • Photos: Memory Lane v2 is adding background music, mute controls, and always-visible navigation dots (#13335). A refreshed onboarding and Local Gallery permission experience is also underway (#13330).
  • Memories Export scaffolding adds progress and cancellation APIs for Android and iOS; media processing will follow later (#13328).
  • Internal iOS users are slated to receive push notifications when Photos albums are newly shared or access is restored (#13320), and Auth is getting settings search (#13300).
  • Additional in-progress work reorganizes the Photos sidebar and updates Rust/Ensu desktop dependencies (#13338, #13337).

item.title: Ente digest Sep 30, 2026 - 57 shipped, 11 in progress
item.description:
Photos shipped a broad set of playback, sharing, background-processing, and reliability improvements across mobile, web, and desktop. Space also gained encrypted reactions and video-post groundwork, while server and CLI changes tightened upload and export handling.

Shipped

  • Photos — slideshows: Album slideshows are now available on the web, with navigation, blurred backgrounds, configurable timing and ordering, auto-hidden controls, and nearby-photo prefetching in #13243, #13252, and #13254.
  • Photos — video and desktop viewing: Mobile video editing and playback now support 0.25x–2x speed controls in #13076. Desktop adds previews for RAF, ORF, PEF, NRW, and SRW files via #13241.
  • Photos — mobile reliability: Uploads retain their locks through native background timeouts, OCR can recover stills from uploaded copies, unsupported face crops stop retrying sooner, and birthday memories use local calendar dates in #13290, #13229, #13230, and #13266.
  • Space: Encrypted emoji reactions—including search, skin tones, and optimistic updates—landed in #13223 and #13224. The server now supports encrypted posts containing up to ten mixed photos and videos in #13279.
  • Web and security: Photos now confirms before discarding unsaved descriptions, and Locker does the same for unsaved changes in #13260 and #13228. Server request bodies are capped at 4 MiB and file-link password attempts are rate-limited via #13270 and #13265.
  • Other fixes: Mobile microphone and log-write crashes were addressed in #13283, and invalid CLI export-deletion filenames are now rejected in #13293.

In progress

  • Short video posts: Space is preparing mixed photo/video posts with locally trimmed clips up to 10 seconds, cover selection, reordering, inline playback, and encrypted uploads in #13291.
  • Photos: iOS startup and simulator compatibility fixes are underway in #13281, alongside redesigned map markers in #13274 and initial-memory notifications in #13242.
  • Auth import hardening is proposed in #13289, and desktop libvips downloads will gain checksum and size verification in #13285.

item.title: Ente digest Sep 29, 2026 - 43 shipped, 10 in progress
item.description:
A busy day focused on user-facing improvements across Ente Photos, Ente Space, and Ente Auth, alongside upload reliability and media-processing hardening. Several mobile and desktop enhancements are also in progress.

Shipped

  • Ente Space: Messages now support encrypted emoji reactions with a searchable picker, skin-tone choices, and improved reaction UI via server support and web support. Profile photos are now displayed in compact, time-grouped sections such as Today, This week, and This month in #13232.
  • Ente Photos: OCR can now recover still images from uploaded copies when local files are unavailable in #13229. Unsupported formats no longer trigger unnecessary face-crop retries in #13230, and On This Day memories remain correctly grouped across daylight-saving changes in #13207. Smart albums also wait for auto-add updates to finish before returning in #13114.
  • Ente Auth: A new “Newest first” sort option puts recently added codes at the top in #13168. New service icons were added for Magento2, Hueber, and PJe in #13216, #13215, and #13167; Open Authenticator import also shipped in #13191.
  • Locker and web: Locker now confirms before discarding unsaved edits or pending uploads in #13228. “What’s new” can be reopened from Locker settings or About via #13162 and #13213. Web maps now send the referrer required for OpenStreetMap tiles in #13201.
  • Reliability: Preview uploads now validate size and MD5 metadata, with mobile support, in #13214; HLS processing is bounded on mobile and web in #13212 and #13211.

In progress

  • Photos: A manual straighten control and upgraded crop editor are proposed in #13204; shared-album uploads could run in the background in #13199; and Memory Lane backgrounds are being precomputed for smoother animations in #13217.
  • Space: A “Last week” profile grouping and larger quick-reaction controls are in #13239.
  • Desktop and Locker: Desktop preview uploads are being migrated to the new metadata flow in #13237, while Android multi-file sharing for Locker is proposed in #13221.

item.title: Ente digest Sep 28, 2026 - 10 shipped, 6 in progress
item.description:
Today’s shipped work focused on mobile account setup and authentication imports, desktop/web image-processing maintenance, and server observability. Several CLI and Photos improvements are also in progress, including a new export flow and upcoming Locker and Favorites controls.

Shipped

  • Mobile: Ente Auth can now import tokens from Open Authenticator, and self-hosted family setup has been fixed: #13191, #13192.
  • Web: The desktop/web image stack now uses the newer libheif-js 1.23.2 resolution as an interim security upgrade: #13183.
  • Server: Rate-limit rejections now emit bounded telemetry for monitoring, while existing behavior and alerts remain unchanged. A no-longer-needed storage-block Discord alert was also removed: #13182, #13188.
  • CLI and infrastructure: Newly created CLI secret files now default to restrictive 0600 permissions without overwriting existing files: #13189. Dependency, toolchain, cleanup, and issue-template maintenance also landed: #13193, #13181, #13185, #13175.

In progress

  • New Photos CLI export: The new Rust CLI is gaining Photos export support: #13194.
  • Safer, more reusable login flow: Rust login state is being separated from interactive prompts, with authentication values removed from HTTP-error and browser-launch logs: #13197.
  • Photos mobile UX: A new Locker link and easier access to “What’s new” are being added, while file info will allow removing items from Quick Links and Favorites: #13190, #13184.
  • Desktop image support: An upcoming libvips upgrade targets security fixes, RAW thumbnails, and Ultra HDR preservation; related work keeps image extensions in temporary files for RAW conversion: #13187, #13186.

item.title: Ente digest Sep 26, 2026 - 5 shipped, 3 in progress
item.description:
Today’s shipped work improves Locker’s document capture pipeline and Photos’ background processing, while Ensu received startup and chat-flow optimizations. In progress, Ente Auth is gaining a newer sorting option, alongside smaller usability and icon updates.

Shipped

  • Locker: Detected document crops are now preserved through review and PDF export, including manual captures, automatic captures, and retakes. This helps ensure the crop users saw is the one carried into the final document.
  • Ente Photos: Internal iOS background processing can now run while the device is on battery, expanding the sync and ML trial beyond devices charging overnight. The experiment remains limited to internal users.
  • Ente Photos: Background album auto-add now refreshes person assignments before processing eligible albums, reducing the chance of using stale assignments when local indexing or ML computation was skipped.
  • Ensu: The app now warms up its model at launch and optimizes chat-title creation, targeting a faster first interaction.
  • Server and CLI maintenance: Legacy KEK hashes are no longer read, stored, or returned by the server, and the field has been removed from the Rust and Go CLI models.

In progress

  • Ente Auth: A “Newest first” sort option would place recently added codes at the top of the list, avoiding manual scrolling or searching.
  • Ente Auth: An icon for Brazil’s PJe judicial 2FA service has been proposed and added to the custom icon database.
  • Locker: A settings entry to reopen the “What’s new” screen is in progress.

item.title: Ente digest Sep 25, 2026 - 21 shipped, 11 in progress
item.description:
Ente shipped a broad set of Photos reliability improvements, alongside several Space interaction and media-quality enhancements. Auth also received visual polish and broader issuer-icon coverage, while upcoming work focuses on encrypted message reactions and more dependable CLI exports.

Shipped

  • Photos and mobile: Background processing for internal iOS users can now run while unplugged, expanding the sync and ML trial to devices that are not charging overnight (#13161). Album auto-add now refreshes person assignments and correctly handles metadata arriving before local files, reducing missed matches after setup and sync (#13160, #13147).
  • People face previews can fall back to the backed-up photo when local files or thumbnails are unavailable (#13149, #13151). Invalid mobile ML embeddings are now skipped instead of interrupting Magic Search or Smart Memories (#13152), and motion-photo extraction uses less memory (#13148).
  • Space: Friends and pending requests now support local search (#13137). Users can swipe right to reply to messages, while multi-photo feed cards keep a stable height during swiping (#13134, #13133). Image editing preserves Display P3 color and allows larger post images (#13136).
  • Auth: Account and verification screens now have consistent illustrations, header colors, dark-mode styling, and a more legible backup prompt (#13143, #13150). Issuer icons were added or refreshed for Yoti, Deel, Remote HR, BuyUcoin, and AJ Bell (#13153, #13124).
  • Locker: Things and Secrets can now be partially available (#13119).

In progress

  • Space reactions: Encrypted emoji reactions are being added at the server level, with notifications retaining existing heart likes (#13165), followed by a searchable picker with skin tones and quick reactions in the web client (#13166).
  • Locker: Detected document crops will be preserved through review and PDF export (#13146), and the What's New screen will be reopenable from settings (#13162).
  • CLI: Open fixes improve exports when changing directories, return a non-zero status on sync failure, and clean up temporary files after failed downloads or decryption (#13142, #13141, #13140).
  • Server and client models are being cleaned up to remove the legacy KEK hash field (#13164).

item.title: Ente digest Sep 24, 2026 - 15 shipped, 9 in progress
item.description:
Ente shipped a set of usability improvements across Space, Photos, and mobile, including smoother messaging, feed browsing, profile management, and more resilient search. Several upcoming Photos and Auth features are also in review, notably image-editor text overlays and Open Authenticator imports.

Shipped

  • Space web: Swipe right to reply in message threads, with a subtle visual indicator (#13134).
  • Space web: Photo feed cards now keep a fixed height while swiping, and profile posts show full-width photos with captions and timestamps (#13133, #13116).
  • Space: Users can remove their profile picture and cover image, returning to the default artwork (#13123).
  • Mobile Photos: Magic Search now recovers from failed queries and handles malformed threshold prefixes as normal search text (#13112).
  • Mobile: Added account controls and collapsible settings pages (#13115).
  • Web Locker: Partial Locker entries are now supported (#13120).
  • Infrastructure and maintenance updates included shared native HTTP handling, web dead-code cleanup, and Space code organization (#13129, #13131, #13118).

In progress

  • Space web: Preserve Display P3 color in image edits and allow larger, clearer post images (#13136).
  • Photos mobile: Add a text tool with fonts, color and background controls, alignment, and larger accessible editor controls (#13121).
  • Photos mobile: Pause videos while file information is open, wait for smart-album people updates to finish, and warn before discarding unsaved descriptions (#13130, #13114, #13113).
  • Ente Auth: Import TOTP codes from password-protected Open Authenticator .bak backups on mobile (#13128).
  • Documentation, Locker partial entries, and an updated AJ Bell icon are also in review (#13135, #13119, #13124).

item.title: Ente digest Sep 23, 2026 - 26 shipped, 9 in progress
item.description:
Today’s changes improve everyday photo and Locker workflows, polish Space profiles, and strengthen mobile reliability. Work in progress focuses on safer editing, smarter-album synchronization, and broader iOS packaging support.

Shipped

  • Photos and mobile: Magic Search now recovers from failed queries and continues with the latest search, while malformed threshold prefixes are treated as normal text (#13112). Collection moves no longer mutate local file state until the server accepts the request (#13106).
  • Locker: Files can be renamed before uploading (#13059), scanned pages can be retaken in place before saving (#13097), and the scanner’s rotate control is clearer and immediately reusable (#13088).
  • Space web: Profile posts now use adaptive, continuous layouts with full-width treatment for small profiles, captions, and timestamps. Sharing and invite wording was refreshed, and likes and replies are clearly identified as private (#13116, #13099, #13091). Accessibility, page titles, and reply behavior also improved (#13079).
  • Ensu: Long native conversations now preserve earlier context using encrypted summaries and retrieval, and chat response interruptions from duplicate instances are fixed (#13085, #13107).
  • Reliability and infrastructure: An iOS native HTTP callback teardown crash was fixed, with platform-specific networking behavior retained (#13081, #13086). Self-hosted Compose setups now use Silo instead of the unavailable MinIO image (#13074).
  • Other shipped work includes a Floxar Auth icon (#13067) and an opt-in bounded PNG decoder for future image-processing use (#13080).

In progress

  • Photos: Smart-album auto-add now waits for updates to finish before returning, and unsaved photo descriptions will trigger a discard warning (#13114, #13113).
  • Mobile: Account controls and collapsible pages are being added (#13115). Locker is also being updated to accept multiple files from Android’s share sheet (#13094).
  • Performance and packaging: OCR inference is being optimized to remove an intermediate tensor (#13111), while SwiftPM support is being added for mail, the panorama viewer, and backup exclusion (#13104, #13103, #13102).
  • An Auth icon for CSBW-Cybersicherheitsportal is also in progress (#13109).

item.title: Ente digest Sep 22, 2026 - 16 shipped, 8 in progress
item.description:
Today’s changes focused on reliability, accessibility, and backend validation across Ente Photos, Ente Space, and shared mobile infrastructure. Several user-facing improvements are also in progress, including video speed controls and file renaming during uploads.

Shipped

  • Ente Space web: Accessibility improvements add better keyboard navigation, screen-reader descriptions, and page titles; photo replies now accept Enter for newlines. Feed captions and photo-position indicators were also polished, and profiles can load up to 250 posts (#13079, #13066, #13061, #13048).
  • Photos and mobile reliability: Background processing can now wait for an active refresh and resume safely afterward (#13073). An iOS crash caused by late native HTTP callbacks was fixed across Photos, Auth, and shared networking (#13081). Native background scheduling was also enabled for selected internal Photos users (#12882).
  • Server: Collection file validation now rejects malformed IDs and encryption material, including on copy requests, before any data is written or billed (#13062, #13069). Repeated referral claims now return a conflict response (#13071).
  • Rust media processing: Added an opt-in, memory-bounded PNG decoder with downsampling, orientation, and color-profile support for future integrations (#13080).

In progress

  • Photos video editor: Upcoming speed controls from 0.25× to 2× will apply to previews and exported videos while preserving audio pitch (#13076).
  • Ensu: Long conversations are being supported with encrypted summaries and retrieval of earlier context within model token limits (#13085).
  • Mobile usability: New album names will use sentence capitalization, and Locker uploads will allow files to be renamed before uploading (#13084, #13059).
  • Self-hosting and Auth: New quickstarts are moving to a pinned Silo object-store image, while Auth is adding a Floxar service icon (#13074, #13067).

item.title: Ente digest Sep 21, 2026 - 10 shipped, 2 in progress
item.description:
Ente shipped a set of user-facing improvements across Space, Photos, and Locker, alongside substantial mobile and ML infrastructure work. Two new changes are in progress, including easier file naming during Locker uploads and stricter server-side validation.

Shipped

  • Space / web: Feed captions now have corrected spacing, photo position dots, and consistent card corners; profiles can load up to 250 posts. PR #13061 · PR #13048
  • Locker / mobile: The document scanner was completely rebuilt for better perspective correction, recovery from difficult page edges, shadow removal, faint-text handling, and document enhancement. PR #13053
  • Photos / mobile: Internal users now use the native background task manager for uploads, while other users continue using Workmanager. The photo permission prompt also now uses “Continue,” addressing app review feedback. PR #12882 · PR #13056
  • Mobile UI: Added menu rows and sheet headers for a more consistent interface. PR #13054
  • ML infrastructure: Added the Rust MlStore library, composing the ML database with vector indexes for clips and cluster centroids; it is foundational work and is not yet consumed by the app. PR #12896
  • Maintenance: Removed unused server triggers and unverified-session alerts, and enabled automated Codex PR reviews. PR #13060 · PR #13057 · PR #13063

In progress

  • Locker: Files can be renamed directly from the file upload screen instead of only after uploading. PR #13059
  • Server: Collection file operations will reject missing file IDs and malformed or incorrectly sized encrypted key material. PR #13062

item.title: Ente digest Sep 20, 2026 - 5 shipped, 3 in progress
item.description:
Ente Space received several user-facing improvements, including richer photo interactions and clearer profile and messaging UI. The mobile Locker scanner also got a camera-permission fix, while server and Auth maintenance work is in progress.

Shipped

  • Ente Space: Photo editing, photo-specific replies, and an invite walkthrough are now available across Space web and Rust components, bringing more ways to interact with shared photos.
  • Ente Space: Unread message indicators regain their ping animation, making new activity easier to notice.
  • Ente Space: Profile photo rows are grouped more clearly, and about-page title wrapping is fixed.
  • Ente Locker mobile: Fixed a camera-permission glitch on the scanner page, improving scanner recovery when access needs to be granted or retried.

In progress

  • Ente Space: Profiles may soon load up to 250 posts, increasing the amount of profile content visible at once.
  • Server: Boot secrets will accept standard or URL-safe Base64, with or without padding, preventing Museum startup failures for secrets generated by common tools such as Helm or OpenSSL.
  • Ente Auth Linux: Pins flutter_secure_storage_linux to 1.2.1 to avoid a keyring serialization compatibility issue.

item.title: Ente digest Sep 19, 2026 - 17 shipped, 1 in progress
item.description:
Ente shipped a broad set of Photos UI improvements across mobile and desktop, alongside fixes for sharing, thumbnails, cleanup feedback, and public links. Core Rust and web work also advanced encrypted file handling and in-app account cryptography, while one Photos fix is now in progress.

Shipped

  • Photos on mobile: The add-person picker was refreshed, and cleanup actions now show progress, item counts, and clearer feedback when nothing can be removed: #13034 and #12989.
  • Raw thumbnail placeholders no longer show misleading expiry or other overlays while images load, including in Trash filmstrips: #13030.
  • Photos gained client support for batch sharing, updated link settings, and a refreshed Memory Lane viewer design: #12990, #13007, and #13024.
  • Public-link viewers no longer expose the Favorite action, while signed-in gallery behavior is unchanged: #13023.
  • Desktop person-naming dialogs now match the People popup styling: #12975.
  • Locker’s scanner now handles camera permissions more reliably: #13040.
  • Auth installations restored without their offline encryption key now show recovery guidance, without affecting signed-in users or existing data: #13031.
  • Rust added Photos file commands, an encrypted CLI replica, and support for files without a file type; authenticated account crypto also stays inside the web app’s WASM: #13037, #13038, and #13033.
  • Additional mobile polish covered grouped information rows, theme updates for open menus and Locker collection icons: #13035, #13025, and #13028.
  • Vecdb updates now preserve routing across vector updates and deletes: #13019.

In progress

  • Photos on mobile: A fix is underway to prevent duplicate shared photos from appearing on the map after being favorited: #13036.

item.title: Ente digest Sep 18, 2026 - 45 shipped, 3 in progress
item.description:
A busy day for user-facing improvements across Photos and Auth, with smoother sharing, importing, and album workflows. The team also shipped multi-photo posts for Space and several reliability and performance fixes.

Shipped

  • Photos: Refreshed the add-person picker and updated link settings in the mobile app (#13034, #13007). Album sharing was also redesigned, and photos can now be removed directly from album chips in the info sheet (#12994, #12969).
  • Photos: Public-link viewers no longer show the Favorite action, while unloaded raw thumbnails no longer display misleading overlays (#13023, #13030).
  • Photos: Cleanup now shows progress, item counts, and clearer feedback when there is nothing to remove (#12989). Video backup also avoids unnecessary FFmpeg log traffic for smoother performance (#13003).
  • Auth: Google Authenticator multi-QR imports now support complete camera and image-based batches with validation and progress feedback (#13017, #13005). Imports from 2FAS, Aegis, and Bitwarden also gain better compatibility and note preservation (#13000, #13002).
  • Locker and Auth: Cancelled files are no longer uploaded from Locker’s pre-upload screen, and restored offline-only Auth installations now provide recovery guidance when their encryption key is unavailable (#13011, #13031).
  • Space: Multi-photo posts are now supported by both the web client and server (#13021, #13022).

In progress

  • Photos CLI: A new Rust-based set of Photos file commands and an encrypted CLI replica is under development (#13037).
  • Photos is addressing duplicate shared map photos appearing after they are favorited (#13036).
  • A notification for when Memories are ready is in progress (#12995).

item.title: Ente digest Sep 17, 2026 - 33 shipped, 10 in progress
item.description:
Photos saw a busy round of usability and performance improvements, while Space’s feed and sharing foundations were restored across the stack. Ensu also received platform maintenance, and several upcoming Photos features are now in progress.

Shipped

  • Photos mobile: Memory Lane v2 received refined controls, captions, title alignment, and improved card placement (#12956, #12986, #12987). Gallery spacing was tightened to 1px, and inactive pointer tracking is skipped to reduce scrolling work (#12988, #12952).
  • Photos usability: Album search now keeps results visible above the keyboard, offers a prefilled Create album action when there are no matches, and provides clearer failure feedback for Referrals and Cast Sessions (#12967, #12946, #12938). Web video playback now fits the full frame on screen (#12947).
  • Space: The feed and its posting/caching UI were restored across server, Rust, and web clients. The nine-friend limit was removed, with pending requests instead capped at 100 per sender and recipient (#12948, #12950). Feed design refinements also landed (#12964, #12971, #12976).
  • Ensu and platform foundations: Duplicate desktop instances now activate the existing window instead of failing during Notes initialization (#12953). Ensu iOS moved to Swift 6 and Android to Kotlin 2, both with shared linting (#12984, #12957).
  • Authentication pages were consolidated across Photos, Auth, and Locker, removing the legacy-UI fallback (#12944). Server uploads now retain more pending-upload metadata, including checksums and client information (#12974).

In progress

  • Upcoming Photos features: A “memories ready” notification is being added (#12995), alongside an album-sharing redesign (#12994) and batch-sharing client support (#12990).
  • Photos is also working on clearer uncategorized-cleanup progress (#12989), removing photos from albums directly in the Info sheet (#12969), and sharing duplicate face-crop requests between thumbnails (#12955).
  • Server work would allow standard or URL-safe, padded or unpadded base64 boot secrets (#12977); Ensu feature documentation is also being updated for v0.1.20 (#12993).

item.title: Ente digest Sep 16, 2026 - 30 shipped, 8 in progress
item.description:
Ente shipped a strong batch of Photos and Space improvements, alongside fixes for sync reliability, mobile flows, and web performance. Several upcoming changes also target smoother Memories, face rendering, and desktop behavior.

Shipped

  • Space: The Space feed, caching, and posting UI are restored across web and Rust, and the nine-friend limit is removed. Pending friend requests are capped at 100 per sender and recipient, with clearer limit errors in the server, web, and Space clients.
  • Photos on mobile: Copying or moving files to a nonexistent album now offers to create it with the searched name prefilled (#12946). Memories now keep separate mute settings for music and video (#12924), captions no longer display quotation marks (#12936), and slideshow durations are longer, including for device albums (#12903, #12904).
  • On iOS, photos are no longer incorrectly shown as not uploaded after signing back in (#12922). Album search includes archived albums (#12919), and large screens get a better-scaled gallery filmstrip (#12838).
  • Photos on web and desktop: Videos now fit the viewer while keeping the full frame visible (#12947), storage usage preserves decimal TB values (#12932), and the desktop All People section is improved (#12891).
  • Reliability: Deleted-share and collection tombstones synchronize correctly, file retries preserve replica locations, and CLI exports handle deleted or renamed collections more safely (#12910, #12937, #12931). Web session crypto now uses the app’s WASM implementation (#12934).

In progress

  • Upcoming Photos improvements: Memory Lane v2 is getting refined controls, layout, and captions (#12956), while duplicate face-crop requests will share one in-flight operation to reduce native work (#12955).
  • Referral and Cast loading errors will use clearer error sheets and loading states (#12938), and Locker documentation is being expanded for document scanning (#12916).
  • Other work includes Auth offline app-lock recovery docs (#12954), preventing duplicate Ensu desktop instances (#12953), append-only vector graphs between rebuilds (#12949), and shared auth-page shell configuration (#12944

item.title: Ente digest Sep 11, 2026 - 48 shipped, 7 in progress
item.description:
